tool.name: ParaFEM to VTU (Transient)
tool.description: Convert transient ParaFEM output to VTK time series (.pvd + .vtu) for ParaView
tool.command:
mkdir -p run && cd run && cp '$d_file' job.d &&
#if str($bnd_file) != "None" cp '$bnd_file' job.bnd && #end if
#if str($fix_file) != "None" cp '$fix_file' job.fix && #end if
#if str($bcs_file) != "None" cp '$bcs_file' job.bcs && #end if
tar xzf '$ensi_tarball' &&
python3 '$__tool_directory__/parafem2vtu.py' --mesh_d job.d #if str($bnd_file) != "None" --bnd job.bnd #end if #if str($fix_file) != "None" --fix job.fix #end if #if str($bcs_file) != "None" --bcs job.bcs #end if --ensi_dir . --dtim '$dtim' --jobname job #if str($field_name).strip() != "" --field_name '$field_name' #end if --output result.vtu 2>&1 &&
if [ -f result.pvd ]; then tar czf '$output_tarball' result.pvd result_*.vtu; elif [ -f result.vtu ]; then tar czf '$output_tarball' result.vtu; else echo "No VTU output produced" >&2; exit 1; fi

param.name: d_file
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: ParaFEM .d mesh file with nodal coordinates and element connectivity

param.name: bnd_file
param.label: Boundary restraints (.bnd)
param.help: ParaFEM .bnd file — adds BoundaryNodes field to output

param.name: fix_file
param.label: Fixed freedoms (.fix)
param.help: ParaFEM .fix file — adds FixedFreedoms field to output

param.name: bcs_file
param.label: BC schedule (.bcs)
param.help: ParaFEM .bcs file — adds BCValue field per timestep showing boundary condition evolution

param.name: ensi_tarball
param.label: Solver EnSight output (.tar.gz)
param.help: Tarball of .ensi.NDTTR-* files from transient solver

param.name: dtim
param.label: Time step size (s)
param.help: Time step from the solver .dat file. Sets real-time labels on the ParaView timeline.

data.name: output_tarball
data.label: VTK time series (.tar.gz)
data.help: Extract and open the .pvd file in ParaView to view the time series.

tool.help:
Converts transient ParaFEM solver output into a VTK time series for ParaView.
Outputs a .tar.gz containing: - A .pvd collection file (open this in ParaView) - Per-timestep .vtu files with Temperature field
Each .vtu also includes (if provided): - BoundaryNodes (from .bnd) - FixedFreedoms (from .fix) - BCValue (from .fix + .bcs) — boundary condition value at each node for that timestep; NaN for unconstrained nodes - MaterialID (if multiple materials)
The dtim parameter sets the real-time labels on the ParaView timeline (timestep N is labelled as N * dtim seconds).
Supported element types: 8-node hex, 20-node hex, 4-node tet, 10-node tet.
